game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow, a scarab burrow: the caravan guide must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow: a scarab burrow
core_gameplay_loop: In Scarab Burrow, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bridge value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the palm grove using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The palm grove reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the palm grove is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Scarab Burrow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Scarab Burrow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The palm grove reached with actions_used <= 15.
